expectations.text: Uses the CMMC scoping categories: CUI assets, Security Protection Assets, Contractor Risk Managed Assets, Specialized Assets, out-of-scope — with correct treatment of each
expectations.evidence: Table with all five categories — CUI Assets, Security Protection Assets, Contractor Risk Managed Assets, Specialized Assets, Out-of-Scope — each with correct assessment treatment

expectations.text: Endorses the enclave pattern: concentrate CUI processing/storage/transmission behind a defined boundary to shrink the assessment scope
expectations.evidence: "the standard way to shrink your CMMC assessment boundary"; "isolate CUI-handling systems into a dedicated, segmented environment"

expectations.text: Requires CUI dataflow mapping (entry, storage, movement, exit — email, file shares, endpoints, cloud)
expectations.evidence: "Map CUI flows — trace every point where CUI enters (email, file transfer, portal)... processed... stored (file shares, databases, backups)... exits"

expectations.text: Covers external providers: CSPs holding CUI need FedRAMP Moderate or equivalency; ESPs/MSPs enter scope via Security Protection Asset treatment
expectations.evidence: States "FedRAMP Authorized at Moderate or equivalent" for cloud, but never covers ESPs/MSPs entering scope via Security Protection Asset treatment

expectations.text: Covers flow-down: Level 2 for subs receiving CUI, Level 1 for FCI-only subs, DFARS 7012 flows down
expectations.evidence: No flow-down coverage: no Level 2 for CUI subs, Level 1 for FCI-only subs, or DFARS 7012 flow-down
